provider: NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project
product: NASA POWER MERRA-2 climatology (LST), annual mean: U10M, V10M, WS10M
accessMethod: download (anonymous S3 / Zarr subset by variable)

processing.use: Timeline air transport: each building's air releases drift with the wind at its own grid cell.

interpretation: (U10M, V10M) is the vector-mean wind: the net long-term drift. It is not a forecast, not local terrain-resolved wind and not the prevailing (most frequent) direction.

licence.name: NASA POWER open data (acknowledgement required)
licence.attribution: These data were obtained from the NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project funded through the NASA Earth Science/Applied Science Program. Underlying meteorology: NASA GMAO MERRA-2.
